## Activity

Market Eye Clinic completed 384 image captures during July 2024. This records the activity submitted for review during the month. The reported capture total provides the basis for assessing image quality and grading outcomes. The clinic should continue to record activity consistently so that monthly performance can be monitored and any operational issues identified promptly.

## Image quality

Of the 384 captures, 74 were ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 19.3 per cent. The result indicates that a significant proportion of images could not be used for grading. Recurring camera issues should be logged with the service desk, as requested by the clinic lead. Maintaining a record of these issues will support follow-up and help identify opportunities to improve image quality.

## Grading

Grading identified 83 referable results during July 2024. The median lag from capture to grading was 8 days. These results should be reviewed alongside the image-quality findings and the reported activity. The clinic lead should continue to monitor the time between capture and grading, while ensuring that ungradable images and recurring equipment problems are recorded through the appropriate service desk process.
